tasks.title: Extract MockWebSocket fake to shared test utility
tasks.detail: Move MockWebSocket class from useDashboard.test.tsx to src/test/fakes.ts for reuse in App.test.tsx. Per test-mocking-strategy: prefer reusable fakes over inline mocks.

tasks.title: Import MockWebSocket from shared fakes
tasks.detail: Replace inline MockWebSocket class with import from src/test/fakes.ts. No behavior change.

tasks.title: Split multi-behavior test into focused tests
violations: behavior-testing: 'Each test verifies one behavior' — second test covers load-content, error-fallback, and clear-selection in one test
tasks.detail: Split 'loads file content and falls back gracefully on file fetch errors' into 3 tests: (1) loads file content for selected file, (2) shows fallback message on fetch error, (3) clears file content when selection is set to null.

tasks.title: Replace vi.mock of internal modules with boundary fakes
violations: test-mocking-strategy: vi.mock('./useDashboard') mocks internal hook instead of WebSocket boundary
behavior-testing: tests break if useDashboard is refactored to Context pattern
tasks.detail: Use MockWebSocket fake at WebSocket boundary + fetch mock at HTTP boundary. Render real useDashboard, LogBrowser, and child components. Assert on rendered output.

tasks.title: Replace vi.mock of internal modules with fetch boundary mock

tasks.detail: Mock fetch at HTTP boundary. Render real useLogBrowser and ToolTimeline. Test loading → loaded → file-selection → timeline-opening flow through actual user interaction.

tasks.title: Run full test suite
